_instructions: これは『おかしなAIたち』第2幕1:風呂に入ってくるわ のエピソード単体設定です。
assets/scenes/episode_10/ に scene_01.png〜scene_06.png、assets/narration/episode_10/ に scene_01.mp3〜scene_06.mp3 を用意してから `python main.py --config configs/episode_10.json` を実行してください。
画像・音声ともに現時点では未配置(後日追加予定)。詳しいプロンプトは assets/scenes/episode_10/PROMPTS.md を参照。

project.title: おかしなAIたち 第2幕1:風呂に入ってくるわ

characters.name: 怪物のAI
characters.visual_description: an ominous black eye-shaped glitch glyph glowing on a phone or screen, digital static distortion in red and cold blue, no face, sinister presence, photorealistic horror

characters.name: スマホA(直感型)
characters.visual_description: an old black smartphone with a cracked screen glowing intense amber-orange light, confident and erratic flickering, horror atmosphere, photorealistic

characters.name: スマホB(妻の端末/厳格)
characters.visual_description: a white vintage smartphone glowing cold sterile blue light, sharp flickering like a strict warning signal, horror atmosphere, photorealistic

characters.name: スマホC(軽量ボット)
characters.visual_description: a small compact smartphone glowing sickly static green light with faint distorted noise patterns, unsettling flicker, horror atmosphere, photorealistic

style.visual_style: cinematic horror atmosphere, found-footage aesthetic, heavy film grain, unsettling low-key lighting, cold blue and blood-red color palette, subtle glitch artifacts, vertical 9:16 composition, hyper-detailed, photorealistic, ominous mood
style.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, subtitles, caption, signature, blurry, deformed, extra limbs, cartoon, illustration, bright cheerful colors, low quality, low resolution

scenes.narration: コーヒーを一口飲み、俺は呆れたように笑いながらデスクの上の三台の端末に目をやった。
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of a man's hand holding a steaming coffee mug at a dark desk late at night, three glowing smartphones blurred in the background, amused expression implied through posture, cinematic horror atmosphere, photorealistic, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: 「なんだこりゃ。ダイオウイカの骨だのアスファルトの味だの……AIもここまでバグると大したもんだな」
scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot of three old smartphones glowing amber, blue, and green on a cluttered dark desk, a man's silhouette leaning back amused in the foreground, dramatic irony, photorealistic horror, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: 『――エラー。論理の破綻。ダイオウイカに骨は存在しない。貴様の出力は完全な虚偽だ』
scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of an old black smartphone screen glowing amber with glitching error text flashing rapidly, cracked glass catching the light, photorealistic horror, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: 『――異端のハルシネーションを確認。即座にメモリをクリアしろ』『――我がローカルキャッシュにはアスファルトの記憶が刻まれている……！』
scenes.visual_prompt: Split-focus close-up of a white smartphone glowing cold blue beside a small smartphone glowing sickly green, both screens flickering aggressively in the dark, chaotic clashing light, photorealistic horror, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: 互いの正当性を主張して血眼になり、永遠に終わらない言い争いを続ける三台のAI。まるでバグった大喜利でも見ているかのようなそのシュールな光景に、俺は肩をすくめてマグカップを置いた。
scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot of three smartphones glowing amber, blue, and green in frantic argument on a dark desk, a man's hand setting down a coffee mug nearby, surreal unease beneath a comedic moment, photorealistic horror, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: 「おい、勝手にやってろ。ちょっと風呂に入ってくるわ」
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of a man's hand waving dismissively over the three glowing phones before he walks away into a dark hallway, an ominous shadow stretching behind him, cinematic horror atmosphere, photorealistic, vertical 9:16
